entities.name: Zoning Code amendments
entities.description: Amendments to the City of Coral Gables Official Zoning Code, including modifications to parking standards, jurisdiction, and regulations for window and hurricane shutters, aimed at updating zoning regulations and standards.

entities.name: Parking requirements
entities.description: Regulations and standards related to parking provisions, including considerations for reducing parking requirements for affordable housing near transit stops, as part of zoning code amendments.

entities.name: Workforce housing
entities.description: Housing provisions and regulations for workforce housing facilities, including citing of city-owned or operated facilities, as addressed in zoning code amendments.

entities.name: Window and hurricane shutters
entities.description: Regulations concerning the installation, closure, and standards for window and hurricane shutters to ensure safety and compliance with city codes.

entities.name: Signs for sale, lease, or rental
entities.description: Regulations governing signage for real estate sale, lease, or rental purposes, including size, placement, and informational standards.
